name: live-v4-turn-identity
objective: v2.3 replan V4, live against the real host event bus (NO model, NO real generation — the real-generation half is owed to L6): ST's own eventSource delivers MESSAGE_RECEIVED/CHARACTER_MESSAGE_RENDERED exactly as script.js:6716/6738 does for a continue/appendFinal on the SAME message id; each continuation commits its own boundary, its event pair commits once, a re-announced normal reply does not, and a MESSAGE_DELETED/MESSAGE_EDITED carrying no id does not rewind a story that has already moved (before V4 a null id was message 0, and a non-finite id passed `shouldRollbackFromMessage` whenever a transition had fired and rewound to boundary 0).

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const settle = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); if (!ctx.chat.length) ctx.chat.push({ name: 'Narrator', is_user: false, mes: 'seed', extra: {} }); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; const fire = async (type, commits) => { const before = rt.getEngineState().boundary; await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_RECEIVED, id, type); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.CHARACTER_MESSAGE_RENDERED, id, type); if (!commits) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); return rt.getEngineState().boundary; } for (let waited = 0; waited < 8000 && rt.getEngineState().boundary === before; waited += 100) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); await settle(); return rt.getEngineState().boundary; }; const b0 = rt.getEngineState().boundary; ctx.chat[id].gen_finished = new Date(Date.now() - 5000); const bNormal = await fire('normal', true); const bAgain = await fire('normal', false); ctx.chat[id].mes += ' more'; ctx.chat[id].gen_finished = new Date(Date.now() - 3000); const bCont = await fire('continue', true); ctx.chat[id].gen_finished = new Date(Date.now() - 1000); const bFinal = await fire('appendFinal', true); const result = { id, b0, bNormal, bAgain, bCont, bFinal }; if (bNormal !== b0 + 1) throw new Error(`a rendered reply did not commit: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (bAgain !== bNormal) throw new Error(`a re-announced reply committed twice: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (bCont !== bNormal + 1) throw new Error(`a continue on the same message committed no boundary: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); if (bFinal !== bCont + 1) throw new Error(`an appendFinal on the same message committed no boundary: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const settle = () => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); await rt.setQuality('approached_board', 'true'); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; ctx.chat[id].gen_finished = new Date(); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_RECEIVED, id, 'continue'); await settle(); const before = rt.getEngineState(); if (before.activeCheckpointId === 'cp1') throw new Error(`setup: the transition never fired, so this step could not discriminate: ${JSON.stringify({ active: before.activeCheckpointId, boundary: before.boundary })}`); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_DELETED, null); await ctx.eventSource.emit(ctx.eventTypes.MESSAGE_EDITED, undefined); await settle(); const after = rt.getEngineState(); const result = { activeBefore: before.activeCheckpointId, activeAfter: after.activeCheckpointId, boundaryBefore: before.boundary, boundaryAfter: after.boundary }; if (after.boundary < before.boundary || after.activeCheckpointId !== before.activeCheckpointId) throw new Error(`a mutation event with no message id rewound the story: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`); return result;
